item.title: security: Detecting sleeper agents hiding in AI model neurons
item.description:
Microsoft Research reported that a capable agent model can be converted into a sleeper agent by editing fewer than 10 neurons to inject a short payload. It also found that frontier agents can detect this kind of threat by identifying anomalous weight edits.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
